description: Fetch content from a public Help Center the user is authorized to copy and start a background import into Weav. The destination must have no current or deleted articles and must never have gone live. The import stages content privately. The user takes the Weav site live separately. Check progress with kb_import_status.

instructions.description: Optional notes for the import, for example which sections to skip.

setup_key.description: Pass the setup_key from verify_signup_code on EVERY setup call, even when OAuth is signed in to another workspace. It selects the workspace and takes precedence over OAuth. Omit only to use the OAuth-connected workspace.

url.description: Public URL of the Help Center the user is authorized to copy.

name: kb_start_import
title: Import an existing help center
